title: One bubble sort pass
summary: Compare adjacent elements from left to right to move the maximum, 5, to the far right in one pass.
context: The input is nums = [4, 1, 3, 1, 5, 2], indexed from 0 to 5. Scan adjacent pairs from left to right. Swap when the left element > the right element, and leave them unchanged when the left element ≤ the right element.

A row of bubbles represents the elements. Larger values have larger bubbles. The array’s left end is the bottom of the water and its right end the surface. A pale green box marks the pair being compared; arcs above and below those bubbles mark a swap just completed.
description: Steps 2 through 6 show the results of comparing or swapping five adjacent pairs. Step 7 identifies the settled position and the remaining range.

frames.title: Represent the array as a row of bubbles
frames.explanation: Each entry of nums = [4, 1, 3, 1, 5, 2] below corresponds to one of the six bubbles above, at indices 0 through 5. Bubble size is proportional to value. No comparisons yet; all six elements await scanning.
frames.key_state: Initial nums = [4, 1, 3, 1, 5, 2]. The six bubbles remain in input order.
frames.announcement: Represent the six elements [4, 1, 3, 1, 5, 2] as bubbles, ready to compare from left to right.

frames.title: Compare and swap indices 0 and 1
frames.explanation: At indices 0 and 1, 4 > 1. Swap the pair. The pale green box now contains [1, 4]. The arcs mark the completed swap. 4 moves to index 1. Now nums = [1, 4, 3, 1, 5, 2]. The scan has reached index 1.
frames.key_state: Indices 0 and 1 swapped: 4 and 1 trade places. Array: [1, 4, 3, 1, 5, 2].
frames.announcement: 4 at index 0 is greater than 1 at index 1. Swapping moves 4 to index 1.

frames.title: Compare and swap indices 1 and 2
frames.explanation: At indices 1 and 2, 4 > 3. Swap the pair. The pale green box now contains [3, 4]. 4 moves to index 2. Now nums = [1, 3, 4, 1, 5, 2]. The scan has reached index 2.
frames.key_state: Indices 1 and 2 swapped: 4 and 3 trade places. Array: [1, 3, 4, 1, 5, 2].
frames.announcement: 4 at index 1 is greater than 3 at index 2. Swapping moves 4 to index 2.

frames.title: Compare and swap indices 2 and 3
frames.explanation: At indices 2 and 3, 4 > 1 (the second 1 in the input). Swap the pair. The pale green box now contains [1, 4]. 4 moves to index 3. Now nums = [1, 3, 1, 4, 5, 2]. The scan has reached index 3.
frames.key_state: Indices 2 and 3 swapped: 4 and the second 1 trade places. Array: [1, 3, 1, 4, 5, 2].
frames.announcement: 4 at index 2 is greater than 1 at index 3. Swapping moves 4 to index 3.

frames.title: Compare indices 3 and 4 without swapping
frames.explanation: At indices 3 and 4, 4 ≤ 5, so the pair stays in place. The box contains [4, 5] without swap arcs. Now nums = [1, 3, 1, 4, 5, 2]. The scan has reached index 4. Next compare 5 with the element to its right.
frames.key_state: At indices 3 and 4, 4 ≤ 5. No swap; the array stays [1, 3, 1, 4, 5, 2].
frames.announcement: 4 at index 3 is less than or equal to 5 at index 4. Leave both in place.

frames.title: Compare and swap indices 4 and 5
frames.explanation: At indices 4 and 5, 5 > 2. Swap the pair. The pale green box now contains [2, 5]. The maximum 5 has reached index 5. Now nums = [1, 3, 1, 4, 2, 5]. All five adjacent pairs have been compared.
frames.key_state: Indices 4 and 5 swapped: 5 and 2 trade places. The maximum 5 has reached index 5. Array: [1, 3, 1, 4, 2, 5].
frames.announcement: 5 at index 4 is greater than 2 at index 5. Swapping moves the maximum 5 to the far right.

frames.title: Maximum 5 in place
frames.explanation: Pass complete. Now nums = [1, 3, 1, 4, 2, 5]. The largest bubble, 5 at index 5, lies to the right of the vertical surface line and turns gray to mark its final position. A brace below marks the remaining range [0, 4] toward the bottom on the left. Its values [1, 3, 1, 4, 2] await later passes.
frames.key_state: Pass complete: maximum 5 is settled at index 5; the remaining range [0, 4] contains [1, 3, 1, 4, 2].
frames.announcement: The first pass ends with maximum 5 in place at the far right. The first five elements remain to be sorted.
